entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
New Zealand's first Michelin Guide has awarded 15 restaurants with the coveted stars, with one Queenstown restaurant being awarded two stars at a glitzy ceremony in Auckland last night | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1
 
Undercover inspectors for the Michelin Guide have been secretly visiting restaurants in Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch and Queenstown for almost a year.
 
110 eateries made it into the guide, with Michelin saying it's rare to award so many stars in a country's inaugural launch. 
 
Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/life/food/i-saw-pictures-when-i-was-a-kid-the-only-kiwi-chef-with-two-michelin-stars
